tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phrin bcol 'di ni chos skyong gtso bsdus yin pas 'di nas rang rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa rnams zur 'don gyi grangs gsog ma gtogs yongs rdzogs stabs gcig gtong mi dgos shing chos skyong rang rang gi bskang gzhung gi phrin bcol gyi thad sor 'di sbyar nas btang na khyer bde don tshang zhig 'byung ngo // hūm̐/ bstan srung gtso bo gur mgon 'khor bcas kyi/ /sa skya'i rje btsun chos srid rgyas pa'i phyir/ /'jam dbyangs gdung brgyud chad med myur 'byon nas/ /sku tshe dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bhyoḥ ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug 'khor bcas kyis/ /sa skya'i sogs rigs 'gre/ ༞ ༈ hūm̐/ stobs 'phrog dbang po yum bzhi 'khor bcas kyis/ /sa skya'i༞༞ ༈ hūm̐/ gnod sbyin beg rtse lcam dral 'khor bcas kyis/ /sa skya'i ༞༞ ༈ bhyoḥ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor bcas kyis/ /sa skya'i ༞༞ ༈ hūm̐/ dam can nor skyong yab yum 'khor bcas kyis/ /sa skya'i ༞༞ ༈ hūm̐/ gsang ba'i las mgon rnam lnga 'khor bcas kyis/ /sa skya'i ༞༞ bhyoḥ dkar bdud lcam dral phur srung 'khor bcas kyis/ /sa skya'i ༞༞ ༈ bai3/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras 'khor bcas kyis/ /sa skya'i ༞༞ ༈ kye/ phrin las mgon po tse'udamar 'khor bcas kyis/ /sa skya'i ༞༞ ༈ kyai/ bstan srung bse yi khrab can 'khor bcas kyis/ /sa skya'i ༞༞ ༈ kyai/ bstan srung rdo rje grags ldan 'khor bcas kyis/ sa skya'i rje btsun chos srid rgyas pa'i phyir/ /'jam dbyangs gdung brgyud chad med myur 'byon nas/ /sku tshe dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// //ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos rje btsun sa skya'i gdung rabs chad med myur 'byon la dmigs nas chos srung rnams la 'phrin bcol rtse gcig tu zhus pa dge/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ chos skyong gtso bsdus kyi phrin bcol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT
